limitations.note: Combining these branches fixed `sf6` but also changed how `idle` handles an X or Z input: the original `if` took the failure branch, whereas the ternary can produce an unknown next state.
The output rewrite satisfies the wildcard requirement but also allows unknown state or reset values to propagate to the outputs in cases where the original conditional logic produced known values.
